Name: Iterations
Description: Number of instances the bombing operation will create. Higher values increase the number of scattered elements.

Name: Multiplier
Description: Quickly multiply the number of bombed instances by increasing or decreasing this value, scaling the overall density.

Name: Size
Description: The minimum and maximum relative size of bombed instances, allowing for variation in the scale of each element.

Name: Size Distribution
Description: Controls the uniformity of the size of bombed instances. Higher values produce more consistent sizes, while lower values allow greater variation.

Name: Rotation
Description: The minimum and maximum range of rotations for the bombed instances, introducing random orientation for each element.

Name: Proportional
Description: Determines whether instances should maintain height-to-size proportion. When enabled, scaling an instance will also scale its height proportionally.

Name: Variable Height
Description: Allows variations in the height of bombed instances, introducing additional randomness to their elevation.

Name: Height
Description: The minimum and maximum range of height variations for the bombed instances, controlling how tall or flat each element can be.

Name: Distribution
Description: The method used to distribute bombed instances across the surface.

Flubs.Name: Random
Flubs.Description: A randomized distribution that results in pure chaotic patterns, scattering instances unpredictably.

Flubs.Name: Grid
Flubs.Description: A normalized grid distribution function that results in a systematic, evenly spaced pattern.

Name: Jitter
Description: The random offset applied to each instance while distributing, adding natural variation to their placement.

Name: Seed
Description: The randomization pattern or seed for the node's process. Changing the seed produces different distribution patterns.

Name: Fade Edges
Description: Softens the edges of bombed instances, blending them more smoothly into the base terrain.

Name: Blend Mode
Description: Specifies how the base terrain and bombed instances are merged together.

Flubs.Name: None
Flubs.Description: Each instance overwrites the underlying terrain at its location.

Flubs.Name: Blend
Flubs.Description: Blends instances with the base terrain using standard blending.

Flubs.Name: Add
Flubs.Description: Adds the height values of instances on top of the base terrain.

Flubs.Name: Subtract
Flubs.Description: Subtracts each instance from the base and previous instances, creating depressions.

Flubs.Name: Difference
Flubs.Description: Creates a difference between the base and each bombed instance, emphasizing changes.

Flubs.Name: Multiply
Flubs.Description: Multiplies the base terrain with each bombed instance, modulating the result.

Flubs.Name: Screen
Flubs.Description: Adds the two inputs without overexposing the output, resulting in a lighter blend.

Flubs.Name: Max
Flubs.Description: Retains the maximum height values of each bombed instance and the base terrain.

Flubs.Name: Min
Flubs.Description: Retains the minimum height values of each bombed instance and the base terrain.

Name: Quality
Description: The level of quality to be used for the bombing operation. Draft is recommended for high-resolution previews, while Medium and High provide better final results.

Flubs.Name: Draft
Flubs.Description: Fastest processing with lower quality, suitable for previews.

Flubs.Name: Medium
Flubs.Description: Balanced quality and performance for general use.

Flubs.Name: High
Flubs.Description: Highest quality with the most detail, recommended for final output.

Name: Add Input
Description: Allows an additional input to be included in the bombing operation, enabling more complex or layered effects.
